adjudication_basis: Both independently attributed security-publisher accounts identify the exact zkSync execution and explain a SyncSwap burn callback occurring before reserve updates. Lending reads inconsistent reserves, enabling over-borrowing and a favorable repayment/liquidation discrepancy. The class follows their shared mechanism, not article titles. Beosin details a sibling execution as its worked example; that does not establish exact localized source targets for this selected hash.

independent_observations.mechanism_excerpt: The main vulnerability exploited in this attack was a read reentrancy in the price oracle
Since borrowing depended on reserves, which weren’t updated before the reentrancy call, the attacker borrowed more than they should have

taxonomy_rationale: Read-only reentrancy is adjudicated from two technical accounts; no publisher-backed exact SWC/DASP assignment is forced.
